text: Server: property-based fuzzing of every JSON endpoint (Hypothesis): never a 500, always the error envelope

On main (dd77e94f), full gate green: Hypothesis fuzz of 17 endpoints (arbitrary JSON, raw bytes, mutated realistic bodies, path ids, bent paths) and a two-device LWW state machine; no 500 and no invariant break found; two routing gaps fixed (doubled slash under the API prefix no longer merges/redirects or reaches the SPA; a newline in an unknown path is the JSON 404). pytest 988->1088, ~150 s; HYPOTHESIS_PROFILE=thorough documented. The main venv has hypothesis installed.
